sources.title: Quran Foundation Developer Terms of Service
sources.note: First-party terms permit monetized apps to display unmodified QF content conditionally; prohibit raw-content resale, impose Content Sync rules, and condition font/image bundling on active account and attribution.

sources.title: JavaScript SDK — Quran Foundation Documentation Portal
sources.note: Official SDK is API plumbing; generated Next.js starter is a working reader/search app but does not document page-faithful Mushaf, hide/reveal, or recitation assessment.

sources.title: Getting Started with Content Sync — Quran Foundation
sources.note: Official docs describe complete canonical Quran core and Mushaf page mappings/positioned words; page data excludes fonts/images and offline copies require periodic sync.

sources.title: Integrating Quran Font Rendering — Quran Foundation
sources.note: Official guide distinguishes Unicode fonts from QCF page fonts and shows the API/font rendering path; it is a rendering guide, not a ready Smart Mushaf.

sources.title: Text License — Tanzil Documents
sources.note: First-party CC BY 3.0 Quran-text terms permit verbatim use in applications with attribution and a link, but forbid changing the text; this does not license page layout or fonts.

sources.title: Terms and Conditions — AlQuran.cloud
sources.note: Service terms claim commercial app reproduction of text is permitted with acknowledgement; audio is licensed on non-commercial terms by default, though commercial bundling is mentioned subject to reciter rights and possible removal.

sources.title: qcf_quran_plus — Flutter package
sources.note: Package documents 604-page QCF rendering and word-level highlights/interactions for native Flutter targets; no Web platform is listed.

sources.title: qcf_quran_plus 0.1.1 License — pub.dev
sources.note: MIT license covers the package code; it does not independently establish commercial or app-store rights for its QCF font/Quran assets.

sources.title: quran_kit — Flutter package
sources.note: Package documents mobile reader screens, QFC4 fonts, embedded Quran text, word-by-word data, audio and 22 reciters; Web is not supported and data rights are separate.

sources.title: quran_kit 0.2.0 License — pub.dev
sources.note: MIT license covers package code only; the package page identifies separately sourced fonts, Quran text, audio and word data.

sources.title: QuranSDK — Android Mushaf rendering SDK
sources.note: Repository documents 604-page canvas rendering, word/ayah highlighting and first-run downloads of database, JSON and fonts; Android only.

sources.title: QuranSDK License — GitHub
sources.note: Apache-2.0 applies to SDK source code; the separately downloaded Quran text and fonts have no independently verified rights in the repository.

sources.title: mushaf-imad-flutter — Itqan Community
sources.note: Flutter reader uses more than 9,000 page PNGs that are not in the package; source pages do not document word-level interaction or a resource-specific commercial grant.

sources.title: mushaf-imad-flutter License — GitHub
sources.note: MIT license covers repository code; it does not establish rights for the separately distributed Quran page images.

sources.title: Quran Engine — Quran.ws
sources.note: Documents 604 page datasets, word hit-testing/masking and intended Web/Android/Flutter/RN coverage, but states the engine binaries and installable package are not published.

sources.title: Licensing — Quran.ws
sources.note: Separates MIT engine code and CC BY 4.0 data from third-party KFGQPC page/font resources whose exact commercial distribution scope remains unresolved in this scan.

sources.title: quran_library 5.0.1 — Flutter package
sources.note: Current package README documents QPC V4 reader, word interactions and built-in Tasmee; Tasmee is hidden on Web and its default live engine uses Quran-Lab Zipformer v3.1.

sources.title: quran_library License — GitHub
sources.note: MIT covers repository code; it does not grant rights to QUL/KFGQPC fonts or Quran resources.

sources.title: quran_library NOTICE: Additional Terms for QCF Fonts and QUL Resources
sources.note: Package maintainer says code MIT excludes QUL/KFGQPC assets; directs apps to upstream terms and summarizes a no-distracting-ads condition.

sources.title: Quran-Lab No-Profit License NPL-1.2
sources.note: Exact model license prohibits charging for the model or any feature it powers, including paid access and advertising; hosted use is free or direct-cost recovery only.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions — Quranic Universal Library
sources.note: QUL says commercial projects may use its data only subject to each resource's license; the FAQ does not grant a blanket license.

sources.title: QPC V4 Tajweed Font Resource 240 — QUL
sources.note: Resource page identifies QPC V4 Tajweed font and distribution formats but does not expose a per-resource commercial license in the captured page.
